Prior accuracy: n=5 at 120/120/5/10-min sweet spots; new matched arms: 6 epochs, n=3; 95% t CI.
Prior FPS omitted: old loader invalid; corrected retiming unstable (same checkpoint: 18.97 vs 32.14 ms).
‡ Zero-finetuning test diagnostics: n=1, no seed SD/CI; native 80c predictions filtered to person.
Fix+tune = restoration + recipe. RTX5060 / 416px / FP32 / batch1 / pipeline, no loading or I/O.
Published † = 1000 / reported latency; unmarked FPS reported directly, not a common throughput measurement.
Published hardware/backend/dtype differ; no common speed ranking. Full protocols and sources: manifest.
